en-GB.description:
A tribute to the legendary Nando Martellone, a character from Boris, the Italian TV show.
Ask Martellone what he thinks about it, and he will reply with his most famous catchphrase.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Martellone what he thinks about it
Alexa, ask Martellone what do you think
en-GB.name: Martellone Boris
en-GB.summary: Ask Martellone from Boris what he thinks about anything. He'll reply with his most famous catchphrase.

it-IT.description: Skill pensata per tutti gli amanti di Nando Martellone, interpretato dal mitico Massimiliano Bruno, nella serie TV Boris.
examplePhrases: Alexa, chiedi a Boris Martellone cosa ne pensa
it-IT.name: Martellone Boris
it-IT.summary: Chiedi a Martellone cosa ne pensa: ti risponderà con la sua espressione più tipica.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: No account linking or setup needed. Say "Alexa, ask Martellone what he thinks about it" (en-GB) or "Alexa, chiedi a Boris Martellone cosa ne pensa" (it-IT): the skill plays a short audio clip and ends the session. Help, Stop and Cancel are supported.
